# Code Anchors: Approvable Decision Record

- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the design stage: the design-warrant gate read off the epic's labels, filing the record as a sub-issue of the epic with a prose-only body, the needs-design to in-progress label lifecycle, the no-design-needed outcome, the reopen-revise-re-close revision flow, and the read of the epic issue's marked discovery gists as an authoritative architect input.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the razor phases: the labelling of invariants and risks, the pre-filing checkpoint that renders refuted alternatives and takes cuts, and the derived body every filing path writes.
- `components/agents/nxs-architect.md` — the offered-not-required rule at the point a refuted alternative is written.
- `common/templates/decision-record-template.md` — the deployable template, with its standing refuted-alternative slot removed.
- `.nexus/config/templates/decision-record-template.md` — the committed-queue copy of that template.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — applies the needs-design label at epic filing from the complexity rollup.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/design.ts` — upserts then applies that label and reports the design-warrant decision.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — the record marker, the needs-design and in-progress label keys, and the design-exempt complexity threshold.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — tells a record sub-issue apart from a story, record-positively, through the shared publishing resolver.
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the four-state record resolution: full on an approved record, blocked on an unapproved or claimed-but-unfiled one, degraded only when the epic genuinely has none.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the any-open-sub-issue hard block, the re-stamp recovery for a record revised after close, and the advisory amendment comment posted when the close-from-diff pass finds a superseded decision.
